definitions.gloss: the rest of a drink left undrunk
definitions.explanation: The part of a drink that has been left in the glass, cup or bottle; also a medicine not taken in full. The drinking counterpart of {食|た}べ{残|のこ}し.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧。
examples.english: To throw away the rest of a drink.

examples.japanese: ⟦コップ→コップ：00862_koppu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飲|の}み{残|のこ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's some leftover tea in the glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{残|のこ}し⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I take my medicine at a fixed time every day so I don't miss any doses.

notes:
From the stem of {飲|の}み{残|のこ}す "to leave part of a drink." With medicine, {飲|の}み{残|のこ}し means pills left untaken, a common term in pharmacies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{残|のこ}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to pour away what's left
- {飲|の}み{残|のこ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ジュース→ジュース：01033_juusu⟧: leftover juice
- ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飲|の}み{残|のこ}し: leftover (untaken) medicine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}みかけ: half-drunk — a drink still in progress, not abandoned
- ⟦{食|た}べ{残|のこ}し→食べ残し：33938_tabenokoshi⟧: leftover food
